name: 28547 · Camp Lejeune, NC
findings: ZIP 28547 (Camp Lejeune) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28547 (Camp Lejeune) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
